STEP 2 - Vessel size:

b) Reference cue: the plate spans roughly 2.5 to 3 times the length of the chicken/meat pieces on the left, which are about 8-10 cm long. That gives about 24-27 cm.
Reconciled width: about 25 cm square, area 625 cm².

- Brussels sprouts (lower left, roughly 12% of the plate, about 75 cm²): cooked sprouts, mounded about 2 cm. Volume 150 ml x 0.6 = about 90 g.
- Kale/leafy greens (right side, roughly 25% of the plate, about 155 cm²): cooked kale-style greens mounded about 3 cm, but partly loose. Volume about 300 ml x 0.6 = about 180 g.
- Mixed salad leaves and chickpeas (scattered on top, small amount): about 25 g of leaves, plus a few chickpeas, about 10 g.
- Sauce/oil residue: thin smear, about 5 g.

Total about 515 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no significant base layer is visible beyond the greens sitting on the plate surface. No adjustment beyond the items above.

- Brussels sprouts, cooked with oil: about 60 kcal/100 g.
- Cooked kale/greens with dressing: about 50 kcal/100 g.
